name: NMN
summary: NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) is an NAD+ precursor sold as a longevity supplement and the flagship molecule of the NAD+ booster category. Human RCTs show oral NMN safely raises blood NAD (MIB-626 trial, PMID 40746868); a 2026 meta-analysis of 10 RCTs found modest blood pressure reductions (resting DBP -2.15 mmHg). Effects are narrower than marketing claims, with dose-response and long-term safety still open questions.
description: Canonical NMN research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until dose-response relationships, longer-term safety data, NMN-vs-NR comparative evidence, and replication of clinical endpoints have passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: NAD+ biosynthesis; mitochondrial bioenergetics; vascular function
